ledger_amendment.reason: 2019 and 2023 operational receipts wrap EAGLE-I fields under `eaglei`, so the initial ledger omitted their nested filtered_sha256 values. This derived-ledger repair computes SHA-256 and byte count from every durable selected CSV and verifies all preexisting receipt hashes match. Operational receipts and source sidecars were not modified.

path_normalization: Paths are repository-relative; raw artifacts are durable ignored cache under data/raw/event-baseline/.
